systems.name: Conversational Product Voice
systems.description: The friendly, plain-spoken register most SaaS products aim for — direct, concrete, warm without performing, calm under failure. Source-neutral, synthesized from public plain-language standards.

systems.name: GOV.UK Style Guide
systems.description: Britain's government content standard — absolute plain language, zero marketing, reading age 9. The gold standard for writing that has to work for everyone.

systems.name: Shopify Polaris Content
systems.description: Shopify's content guidelines for merchants — confident, empowering, action-oriented. Written for business owners who want momentum, not a lecture.

systems.name: Atlassian Design System Content
systems.description: Atlassian's voice across Jira/Confluence/Trello — bold, optimistic, practical. Written for teams, collaborative in tone, never condescending.
